description: R54-R56 checklist applied to 5 no-go theorems

checklist.propagator_regime: contact (1/m_phi^4) for m_phi >> q, long-range (1/q^4) for m_phi << q
checklist.dimensional_check: sigma must have units cm^2/g; standard form uses (hbar c)^2 not (hbar c)^4
checklist.velocity_handling: full Maxwell-Boltzmann integral preferred over single v
checklist.coupling_structure: g_N (DM-nucleon) vs g_chi (DM-DM) hierarchy per R57

propagator_regime.note: Magnetic dipole is a contact operator (dimension-5); no separable mediator propagator

dimensional_check.note: sigma_SI formula uses alpha_EM^2 mu_chi^2 m_N^2 / pi in natural units, converted via (hbar c)^2

velocity_handling.note: Single-velocity evaluation at v_DD. For magnetic dipole, sigma_SI is independent of v (operator is contact). No velocity integral needed.

coupling_structure.note: Magnetic dipole couples to nucleon EM charge, not via g_chi. Coupling structure is fixed.

results.recommendation: Keep as-is; magnetic dipole operator is intrinsically contact, R54-R56 checklist less applicable

results.literature_citation: Zhang 2016 (cited but specific realization falsified by referee 2026-09-19)

propagator_regime.note: No-go is kinematic, not DD-amplitude. Delta_m vs KE_CM argument.

velocity_handling.note: Uses v=28 km/s as galactic characteristic velocity (single v is correct here for KE_CM)

coupling_structure.note: Inelastic DM with explicit Delta_m; coupling structure is Delta_m-controlled

results.recommendation: Keep as-is; kinematic no-go is robust to R54-R56 checklist

results.literature_citation: Original argument (Tucker-Smith & Weiner 2001 for inelastic DM kinematics)

propagator_regime.note: Kinematic no-go (Delta_m vs KE_CM); no DD propagator calculation

dimensional_check.note: Mass ratio m_chi vs Delta_m is dimensionless; KE_CM vs Delta_m is dimensionless

velocity_handling.note: Single v=28 km/s used for KE_CM (correct; this is the maximum halo v)

coupling_structure.note: Kinematic constraint on Delta_m; coupling structure is fixed by m_chi, Delta_m

results.recommendation: Keep as-is; razor-thin Delta_m window (0.3 keV) is the no-go mechanism

propagator_regime.note: Literature result; P1 formula (Eq 7, narrow-width approximation) is taken as-is from Chu+ 2019

dimensional_check.note: Chu+ 2019 Eq 7 is dimensionally consistent: sigma_0/m (cm^2/g) + resonant term. Verified by T131_chu_pwave_verification.py

coupling_structure.note: P1 is a specific literature benchmark; no DM-DM vs DM-N coupling assumed

results.correct_above_LZ_by: N/A (P1 does not fit Cloud-9; 2/8 channels fail)
results.recommendation: Verify P1 parameters (m_DM_tilde = 400 MeV, v_R = 108 km/s, gamma = 1e-3, sigma_0/m = 0.1 cm^2/g) against Chu+ 2019 paper text. If confirmed, hold.

results.description: One-mediator UV systematic (dark photon OR Higgs portal)
results.literature_citation: Original argument (no specific paper; standard WIMP-miracle + thermal relic arguments)

propagator_regime.note: No DD propagator; the no-go is thermal relic vs SIDM phenomenology tension

dimensional_check.note: sigma_HH in cm^2/g; Omega_h^2 dimensionless; <sigma*v> in cm^3/s. All consistent.

velocity_handling.note: Thermal freeze-out at T_f ~ m_chi/20 (correct; this is the standard assumption)

coupling_structure.note: INTENTIONAL: one-mediator model has g_D = g_chi = g_N by construction. The 8-13 order gap is the no-go mechanism.

results.recommendation: Keep as-is; the g_N=g_chi assumption is the no-go, not a bug. R57 two-mediator solution (Drobczyk 2025) breaks this assumption.

language_recommendation.T184: ruled-out completion (internal, but the g_N=g_chi mechanism IS the no-go)

time_estimate_actual: ~2 hours (most were kinematic arguments or literature citations, not subject to R54-R56 checklist)
R60_reviewer_estimate_was: 6-8 hours (per reviewer, but this re-check found no errors)

T131_Chu_2019.title: Velocity Dependence from Resonant Self-Interacting Dark Matter
T131_Chu_2019.verdict: T131 citation correct, P1 parameters verified, no-go holds
